description: This file is a documentation / markdown source describing the HDMIOutput HAL interface, including overview, features, capabilities, state machines, and system integration details.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes supported video formats, pixel formats, color spaces, HDR modes, and other capabilities of an HDMI output port.

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Defines supported HDR output modes such as HDR10, HLG, etc.

classes.name: SPDSource
classes.description: Enum for identifying source product description (SPD) information.

classes.name: VIC
classes.description: Enum defining HDMI Video ID Codes for various supported resolutions and refresh rates.

classes.name: Property
classes.description: Key-value pair structure used for setting or querying HDMI properties such as VIC, content type, AFD, etc.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of a specific HDMI output port, including supported formats, VICs, HDR modes, etc.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Configures a property on the HDMI output, such as VIC, HDR mode, content type, or AFD.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates HDMI signal output, including HDCP authentication if applicable.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Ceases HDMI signal output and optionally releases resources.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the HDMI output port, releasing any associated resources.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the HDMI port for configuration and signal transmission.
